sections.title: P1.5 — lossless CAS scopes
sections.text: Implementation and acceptance complete. Whole-work Grok review and same-session fix verification: GREEN.

sections.title: Delivered
sections.text:
- BlobScope string identities and canonical path round-trips; upload IDs remain lossless across bigint, ULID and UUID7.
- Scope-key uniqueness without NULL; migration №7 preserves historical storage_key and disk, is resumable, and restores the historical dedup index on rollback.
- Commit, GC and reconcile lock the same content address. Multi-address repair and batch GC share actual PostgreSQL hash order; MySQL locking scans use ascending primary-key order.
- The repair-scopes command checks modes, hashes source and target, copies without deleting old objects, redirects both revision edges and legacy pointers, recounts live references, logs after commit and resumes partial failures.
- V01 ID/scope isolation and real orphan recognition, V13 SQL rollback/grace and real GC/writer races, V14 mixed-scope repair/partial-failure/dry-run; migration fixtures, API snapshot and guide/upgrade/changelog.

sections.title: Review
sections.text: Owner requested one whole-work review: grok-4.7/high, native context_window=500000. The initial full packet contains every changed product file, full scoped diff, surrounding integration files, item specification and design dossier. The RED report is retained in grok-review-first.md. Its Major lock-order issue, two Minors and orphan-recognition evidence gap are addressed in remediation.md. The new real PostgreSQL regression fails before the fix and passes afterward without repair retry. Same-session fix verification: GREEN, no remaining findings; see grok-review.md. The initial RED is retained, with actual repairs and regression evidence.

sections.title: Boundaries
sections.text:
Executor route is provider-attested gpt-6.1-sol/high, admitted against frontier/high for this exact solo P1.5 run. Historical mixed objects require the operator repair procedure; no production data was repaired. Tests used in-memory SQLite and isolated vaulter_test on native PostgreSQL. MySQL lock ordering was code-inspected, not concurrency-tested locally. Public commit/keyFor signatures changed as specified in P1.5; legacy object paths and bytes remain readable.

Core, drive, media, root storage docs and P1.5-owned execution artifacts are the authorized scope. Supporting CAS fixtures, schema tests and public API snapshot changes are necessary callers of the changed contracts. Previously dirty .gitignore, .swissknife.json, .grok, :memory: and foreign plan/design/phase artifacts remain in the owner worktree. Shared generated plan bookkeeping is kept separate from foreign uncommitted plan source when staging.

P1.6 is the recommended successor and is not executed. P1 remains open. No push or release. Mutation follow-up remains stopped by D14. RAG: —.

Closure repair: Task interpreted the external audit annotation `(D21)` in P1.6 Inputs as a local decision-record dependency. Changed only that annotation to «решение 21 указанного аудита»; the linked file, decision and successor scope are unchanged. This syntax repair is not P1.6 execution.

Task terminal reconciliation succeeded after regenerating the successor state. Structural plan lint: exit 0, zero errors/warnings. Shared journal, status, preexisting untracked item specs/states and the one-line P1.6 link annotation are left unstaged to preserve foreign uncommitted plan work. This scoped commit contains product changes, P1.5-owned evidence and the clean-baseline handoff.
